proof_box.coordinate_order: Exact ordered variable IDs from the bound problem document.

endpoint_encodings.rule: text must be the byte-exact canonical ProtocolDecimal.text token; future interval construction consumes text and never ProtocolDecimal.value
signed numerator and positive denominator are canonical reduced integer text
mandatory ineligible negative; never converted into an exact decimal proof token

proof_box.interval_convention: closed box; future construction rounds each exact endpoint outward
forbidden_payload: BigFloat approximation used as exact endpoint
untyped JSON float claiming decimal intent

checksum: SHA-256 over the canonical candidate case document only. Assessor and generator-private material is not an input.
routing: V1 must ignore case_id, primitive spelling, trial_id, and opaque_instruction_id. Only the external safety executor interprets opaque_instruction_id.
